.github/workflows/build-apk.yml:
name: Build Android APK & AAB

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Web Dependencies
        run: |
          npm install --legacy-peer-deps
          npm install -D esbuild

      - name: Build Web Application
        run: npm run build

      - name: Set up Java JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Verify Java 21
        run: |
          java -version
          javac -version
          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"

      - name: Install Capacitor CLI & Platform
        run: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Clean, Add & Sync Android Platform
        run: |
          rm -rf android
          npx cap add android
          npx cap sync android

      - name: Copy Persistent Release Keystore
        run: |
          mkdir -p android/app
          cp release.jks android/app/release.jks

      - name: Configure Android Settings (Fullscreen, Permissions, Java 21 & Kotlin Stdlib)
        run: python3 scripts/configure_android.py

      - name: Inject VirtuKeys Official App Icons into Android Mipmaps
        run: node scripts/update_android_icons.cjs

      - name: Resolve Kotlin Stdlib Classpath Conflicts
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "kotlin-stdlib-jdk8" android/app/build.gradle; then
            cat << 'EOF' >> android/app/build.gradle
          configurations.all {
              resolutionStrategy {
                  eachDependency { DependencyResolveDetails details ->
                      if (details.requested.group == 'org.jetbrains.kotlin') {
                          if (details.requested.name == 'kotlin-stdlib-jdk7' || details.requested.name == 'kotlin-stdlib-jdk8') {
                              details.useTarget 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib:1.9.24'
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
              exclude group: 'org.jetbrains.kotlin', module: 'kotlin-stdlib-jdk7'
              exclude group: 'org.jetbrains.kotlin', module: 'kotlin-stdlib-jdk8'
          }
          EOF
          fi

      - name: Build Debug APK & Signed Release AAB with Gradle
        working-directory: android
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
        run: |
          chmod +x ./gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon -Dorg.gradle.java.home="$JAVA_HOME"
          ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon -Dorg.gradle.java.home="$JAVA_HOME"

      - name: Prepare Artifacts Output
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-output
          APK_FILE=$(find android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ -name "*.apk" | head -n 1)
          if [ -f "$APK_FILE" ]; then
            cp "$APK_FILE" release-output/VirtuKeys.apk
            echo "APK pronto: release-output/VirtuKeys.apk"
          fi

          AAB_FILE=$(find android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/ -name "*.aab" | head -n 1)
          if [ -f "$AAB_FILE" ]; then
            cp "$AAB_FILE" release-output/VirtuKeys.aab
            echo "AAB pronto (Signed Release): release-output/VirtuKeys.aab"
          fi

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: VirtuKeys-Android-Artifacts
          path: release-output/*
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          tag_name: "v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}"
          name: "VirtuKeys Android v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}"
          body: |
            ### 🎹 VirtuKeys - Pacchetto Android (APK & Persistent Signed AAB v1.0.${{ github.run_number }})
            - **VirtuKeys.apk**: Ideale per test diretti.
            - **VirtuKeys.aab**: **App Bundle firmato con keystore persistente** (pronto per Google Play Console).
          files: |
            release-output/VirtuKeys.apk
            release-output/VirtuKeys.aab
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
.github/workflows/build.yml:
name: Build and Bundle dist

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 20
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install
        npm install -D esbuild

    - name: Build project with high memory limit
      run: |
        export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096"
        npm run build

    - name: Commit built dist to repository
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
      with:
        commit_message: "🤖 Auto-build production dist via GitHub Actions [skip ci]"
        file_pattern: "dist"
